answer: Each epoch, the ledger orders a haven transcript audit: it replays a past answer under a fresh canyon nonce and demands re-derivation within 90 seconds, comparing each step to the stored derivation. Verifiers check the jetty nonce binding and the timing of every step. One honest agent re-derives one transcript in 90 seconds; 10 fakes must re-derive 10 transcripts under 10 fresh nonces, since each nonce binds to one identity, scaling compute cost linearly. Peers audit the replay log and slash the bond of any agent whose re-derivation diverges or misses the deadline.
